title: Peanut Admin v3.0.12 Demo experience audit

method.raw_artifact_policy: Raw hidden capture files remain process evidence; durable references and selected screenshots are listed in demo-experience-evidence.json.

sites.surface: user settings, operation logs, mobile decoration and Tabbar decoration
operation-log query/reset/export, website settings, dictionary, decoration and user settings

issues.expected: An authorized action completes; an unavailable capability is hidden or disabled with an explanatory state.
issues.observed: Visible menus or buttons repeatedly produced the UI message 暂无访问权限 after interaction. The exact failing endpoint was not attributed to one action in this capture.
issues.impact: The Demo presents expected operations as broken instead of explaining persona limits.

issues.expected: An unconfigured or unavailable provider returns a stable observable status, reason and readiness state.
issues.observed: The storage route returned HTTP 500 twice during the capture.
issues.impact: An operator cannot distinguish normal unconfiguration from an application failure.

issues.expected: Every readiness item has a stable localized title.
issues.observed: The page and console exposed readiness.items.undefined.title; zh, en-US and en all lacked the key.
issues.impact: The readiness page contains incomplete copy and adds console noise.

issues.expected: Decoration navigation labels resolve through stable locale keys.
issues.observed: 装修管理, 移动端装修, Tabbar 装修 and PC 装修 emitted missing-key and fallback warnings.
issues.impact: Navigation falls back to raw labels under strict locale or language switching.

issues.expected: The checkbox component uses the current value API without repeated deprecation warnings.
issues.observed: The console repeatedly reported [el-checkbox] [API] label act as value is about to be deprecated in version 3.0.0.
issues.impact: The current page is noisy and carries a known future component compatibility risk.

issues.expected: A trusted Tenant session remains usable; if it expires, subsequent requests stop with one consistent session state.
issues.observed: The capture first showed 暂无访问权限 and later showed 租户会话不可用 while decoration menus and an empty page state remained visible.
issues.impact: The capture cannot distinguish a stale audit session from a real session recovery defect.

sites.surface: tenant operation surface; source capture did not preserve attribution

issues.expected: A 404 record includes URL, Host and navigation source so an unknown route can be reproduced or closed.
issues.observed: Three snapshots contain only 404 / not found and do not include URL or Host.
issues.impact: The route cannot be assigned to Tenant A, Tenant B or a deliberate unknown-route check.

sites.surface: default, Tenant A and Tenant B lifecycle details

issues.expected: A successful detail read shows a success state; an error does not coexist with apparently successful detail data.
issues.observed: All three detail actions showed 请求失败，请稍后重试 while the corresponding Tenant detail dialog still displayed data.
issues.impact: An operator cannot tell whether the action succeeded or failed.

repair_map.purpose: Align Demo persona menu/button/API projection and attribute any Tenant-session failure.
Make storage and Tenant-detail feedback states stable and non-contradictory.
Restore locale keys and move checkbox usage to the current component API.
Document Release, Demo overlay and application artifact identity boundaries.
Recheck affected paths on one fixed candidate and retain URL/Host attribution.

not_executed: Tenant pause, close, delete or other irreversible lifecycle actions
Log clearing, password changes or destructive Demo writes
Real Storage, payment, messaging, OAuth or other external Provider calls
Real funds, orders, refunds or third-party business data flows
A complete comparison matrix for a second shared Admin persona
Complete public PC, H5 and callback end-to-end flows
Attribution of the DA01 failing endpoint and the three DA07 404 URLs/Hosts/navigation sources

redaction.note: This index stores public Demo hosts, synthetic page observations and relative evidence paths only.
